value.PublicRemarks: Start your next chapter in this lovely townhome on a quiet circle in highly sought-after Armitage village, one of Newmarket's most affordable and family-friendly neighbourhoods. Enjoy the ideal 1400 sq ft floorplan Plus a Professionally Finished Basement with Rec Room; this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and everyday functionality. The spacious main floor features bright living and dining areas ideal for family gatherings, movie nights, or entertaining friends. The updated, sun-filled eat-in kitchen with huge breakfast area walks out to a private deck surrounded by mature cedars for a quiet moment outdoors. Upstairs, the oversized primary suite offers a private sanctuary with 2 double closets, and a versatile sitting area ideal to read, work from home or exercise. Two additional generously-sized bedrooms and a full bathroom provide plenty of space for a growing family. The finished basement adds valuable living space with a recreation room for kids, hobbies, games, or entertaining, plus a separate utility/laundry room with handy workshop to suit today's flexible lifestyle. Enjoy convenient direct garage access and modern updates including hardwood floors 2nd.  $$ Spent on updates: updated Eat-in Kitchen w SS Appliances, Granite countertops & Backsplash; Lennox Furnace '22, Windows (all but 2 back bedrooms replaced- windows and garage doors 50/50 split cost condo/homeowner), Roof recently replaced by Condo Corp. Low condo fees provide peace of mind and a convenient low-maintenance lifestyle (grass cutting, roof and more). Ideally located steps to Armitage Village Public School and Sir Wm Mulock Secondary School, Playter parkette, scenic Tom Taylor walking trails, and Yonge St. Transit and amenities making this an ideal central location in one of Newmarket's most desirable communities! Minutes to shopping, restaurants, Ray Twinney Recreation Complex, GO Transit, and easy access to Hwy 404 & 400 make commuting and daily life effortless. (id:65552)
value.Directions: Cross Streets: Yonge St & Savage Rd. ** Directions: Shanahan Blvd to Playter Cres.
